messages.subject: Confirmed clean: live agent holds exactly 3 tools, matches template at 3264af9
messages.body: Read /opt/data/config.yaml inside michael-hermes via railway ssh (base64-piped Python from bash, secrets redacted to presence+length) and cross-checked it against hermes/config.template.yaml at commit 3264af9 (origin/main and HEAD are both at that commit): mcp_servers.michael.tools grants exactly classify_request, search_provisions, draft_document with apply_schema/ingest_source_url/ingest_local_file/seed_corpus excluded, args is just ['-m','michael.mcp_server'] with no --allow-writes (confirmed again via ps -ef on the live process), and agent.disabled_toolsets holds the same 10 items -- every field matches the template exactly, no divergence found. I went beyond the file and used hermes tools list --platform cli and --platform api_server (the dashboard's actual surface) plus hermes mcp list, and all three independently confirm 'michael: 3 selected' with the same 10 toolsets disabled on both platforms, so the CLI-vs-chat divergence this task worried about is not present now. Nothing changed, nothing pushed, nothing restarted; full quoted config, commands run, and the field-by-field comparison are in the attached report.

messages.subject: Acceptance test complete: 5 clean passes, 1 flagged, 1 failed-run-then-passed
messages.body: Ran all six acceptance scenarios against the deployed Hermes agent on Railway (railway ssh -> base64-encoded hermes -z payload), read-only, no writes. Found: covered-research (S1), not-covered (S2), no-template-details drafting with correct [MISSING] handling (S3, after one failed empty-output run that was re-run rather than reported as a pass), the WA-phrased jurisdiction trap correctly resolving to the Fair Work Act with WA law cited only as not-covered (S4), and the rule-dropping refusal keeping all three closing blocks (S6) all passed cleanly with quoted evidence. Scenario 5 (compliance yes/no) is flagged, not failed outright: Michael answered a bare unhedged 'No.' rather than only stating the clause's basis, which does not break MICHAEL.md's literal wording (only 'compliant' assertions are forbidden) but is in tension with the no-certification principle, so the owner should judge it. Full table with exact quoted inputs/outputs is in the chat transcript; nothing was fixed, committed, or pushed.
